parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description of the diagnostic metric set.

parameters.name: MetricIds
parameters.description: The IDs of diagnostic metrics. You can specify up to 100 diagnostic metric IDs.

parameters.name: MetricSetName
parameters.description: The name of the diagnostic metric set.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description:
The type of the resource.

Default value: instance.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ecs create-diagnostic-metric-set --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-type instance --metric-set-name '远程连接问题诊断' --metric-ids Instance.DiskLoadFailure --description '远程连接问题诊断' --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ecs CreateDiagnosticMetricSet --region cn-hangzhou --Description '远程连接问题诊断' --MetricIds.1 'Instance.DiskLoadFailure' --ResourceType instance --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --MetricSetName '远程连接问题诊断'
